simple.meaning: מַחֲמָאָה (machămâʼâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something buttery (i.e. unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) flattery.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחֲמָאָה (H4260) before moving outward to related references.
